name: ReengagementSettings
description: Private server-controlled settings for the opt-in older inactive account reminder

settings_key.description: Stable single-record settings key, currently default

enabled.description: Whether the daily re-engagement reminder is enabled

updated_by.description: Verified administrator email that last saved the reminder

last_run_at.description: Server timestamp of the most recent scheduled check

last_run_count.description: Number of reminder emails sent by the most recent scheduled check

last_run_error.description: Safe bounded summary of the most recent scheduled check issue
